Comment_glosser: Historically, 20 in Semitic was formed as 10 with a dual marker and the other decades as 3, 4 etc. with a plural marker (Brockelmann 1916: 119). However, the suffixes have been regularized leading to the synchronically confusing system where 20 vs. other decades seem to be formed with the same suffix but different operations. I believe that here, the regularized suffix is that of the historic dual, but I am not sure whether it is still a dual or a plural synchronically. Numerals from 20 onwards could also be loans because the forms do not exactly match the expected Mehri sounds.
